tiebreakers.description: Still tied: the player who went later in turn order wins

notes: Points during play (in-play): animals score immediately incl. re-scoring same animal type in the pasture; selling goods 2-4 VP per tile; completed region scores by size (1-8 spaces: 1-36 VP) plus phase bonus (10 in phase A down to 2 in E); first to cover a colour takes the large bonus tile (5/6/7 VP for 2/3/4 players), second takes small tile (2-4 VP). All of that is already on the VP track. Six-sided tiles left in storage score nothing. Yellow tile rows apply only if you own that tile; each row is count x points. Solo mode has its own target score (not modelled). Rulebook used is the Ravensburger/alea English rulebook; the 2019 edition PDF could not be fetched directly but a search extract of it matched the same final scoring and tiebreakers.
